title.en: Irazu no Hime wa Jinrou no Kuni de Aisare Ouhi to naru!
Toraware Hanahime no Shiawase na Gosan
Kakan no Oukoku no Hanagirai Hime
Niehime no Konin - Migawari Oujo wa Teikoku de Saiai to naru
Keiyakukon shita Aite ga Oni Saishoudeshitaga, Kono-do Saishou-shitsu Sennin Hosa-kan ni Ninmei sareta Jimi Bunkan (Hensouchuu) wa Watashidesu
Suterareta Jimi Oujo wa Byakurou Denka ni Dekiaisareru
Hakoiri Koujou wa Shikou no Koi wo Onozomi desu! - Risou no Tonogata wo Sagasu Tabi ni Demasu. Tadashi, Utsukushisha Igai Mitomemasen!?
Usotsuki Heika ga Watashi ni Shuuchaku Suru Riyuu
Doumo, Akuyaku ni Sareta Reijou desukeredo
Eiyuu-sama, Wakeari Osanazuma wa Ikaga desu ka?
Suterare Hanayome no Saikon - Koori no Henkyou Haku wa Saiai o Chikau
Kon'yakusha ga Uwaki Aite to Kakeochi shimashita. Ouji Denka ni Dekiaisarete Shiawase na no de, Imasara Modoritai to Iwarete mo Komarimasu.
Kinou made Namae mo Yonde Kurenakatta Koushaku-sama ga, Kyuu ni Dekiai shitekuru no desu ga?
Ochibure Saijo no Koufuku Heika ni Suterareta no de, Saiai no Hito wo Sukui ni ikimasu
"Jimide Tsumaranai" to Suterareta no de, Jimichi ni Renkinjutsushi wo Mezashimasu!
Konyaku haki sareta muhyoujou reijou ga shiawase ni naru made ~Kinmusaki no tennen tarashi kishidan-chou-sama ga torottoro ni amayakashite dekiai shite kuru no desu ga!?~
